purpose: Preserve the first Campaign171 terminal gate failure and authorize only deterministic Black formatting before an unchanged full gate retry.

attempt.command_scope: python -m black --check Campaign171 test, then Ruff and focused pytest under fail-fast
attempt.observed: Black reported that the Campaign171 terminal test would be reformatted and exited 1; fail-fast prevented Ruff and pytest from starting.

recovery.allowed_change: Run Black once on only the Campaign171 terminal test file.
recovery.required_retry: Black check, Ruff check and focused pytest from repository root under fail-fast.
